general_information.name: OH—FULL LEGAL NAME, RIGHT. IT’S MAYA SANDBERG.

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s been… kind of hard to sort out. Since I moved to Toronto for work, I’ve been feeling low a lot, not sleeping properly, and I just don’t feel interested in things the way I used to. I’ve got hardly any friends here, so I end up kind of keeping to myself. I also skip meals sometimes, and I’ve been avoiding video calls with my family back home, which feels bad because I’m close to them. It’s been going on for about five months now.
current_concerns.goals: I want to feel like myself again, mostly. And… maybe make some friends here, instead of just counting down the days till I go back home.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and raised in Halifax, and… I remember it as a happy childhood, pretty sociable too, I had friends and was generally outgoing.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I finished my architecture degree, and then I moved to Toronto when I was 21. That’s… kind of the big thing that changed everything.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I’m single. Nothing else really to add there.
personal_history.future_goals: I want to build a life here, instead of just counting the days until I can visit home.
